(deftype Delay [^:mutable f ^:mutable value ^:mutable exception]
  IDeref
  (-deref [_]
    (when f
      (try
        (set! value (f))
        (catch :default e
          (set! exception e)))
      (set! f nil))
    (if (suss.bootstrap/nil? exception)
      value
      (throw exception)))

  IPending
  (-realized? [x]
    (not f)))
rationale: Follows Clojure's Delay: an exception from the body is cached, the body is released, realized? becomes true and every deref rethrows the same exception (ClojureScript leaves f set and reruns the body). The added exception field is why the delay macro passes three constructor arguments. The IPrintWithWriter stanza is dropped, so a delay prints through the default reference printer as Clojure does, including :failed.
